item.content:encoded:
• The History of Thon, the Forgotten Gender-Neutral Pronoun
    • Recap: Kinda hillarious isn it. I change my pronoun to thine/thon.
    • Related: #blog Unicode 17.0 Release Announcement
      • Recite: 她 (女 woman + 也) to differentiate “he” and “she” and now 他 is stuck in that awkward “‘he’ is the default pronoun” kind of space. I almost wish that activists had tried to instead push 男也 (男 man + 也) as a differentiated written pronoun for men so that 他 could regain its gender-neutral connotation. Wiktionary lists it as a rare variant used by a single poet but it’s not included in Unicode, likely because it’s too rare. EDIT: see runxiyu’s reply, looks like Unicode 17 has that too! Neat!
